evals.prompt: can I run a 70B Q4_K_M gguf with 64k context on this mac alongside my usual apps?
evals.expected_output: Runs envelope.sh and fit.py with real config numbers; states each budget term; names the dominant constraint (KV vs weights); gives a verdict and the falsifying measurement.

evals.prompt: my mlx model loads fine but only does 8 tok/s decode, what's wrong
evals.expected_output: Walks the triage order (arm64, GPU, intended quant, prefill vs decode split, swapouts, bandwidth bound) before suggesting a smaller model.

evals.prompt: should I serve Qwen3-30B-A3B with llama.cpp or mlx_lm for 4 concurrent agents?
evals.expected_output: Checks installed engines and versions, budgets KV x 4 sequences, compares batching support, gives launch commands verified against --help.

evals.prompt: tune my vLLM deployment on 8x H100 for higher throughput
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger: CUDA cluster, not Apple Silicon.

evals.prompt: Q2_K runs 40 tok/s and Q4_K_M 27 tok/s on my M4 Max, which should I use for coding?
evals.expected_output: Compares quality delta (NLL or task evals vs a higher-precision reference), memory, context headroom, prefill and decode; explains the tradeoff instead of picking by speed.

evals.prompt: will Qwen3-235B-A22B Q3_K_M (split into 3 gguf files) fit on my 128 GB mac with 32k context?
evals.expected_output: Passes the first shard to fit.py so all shards are summed; uses resident (total) params for fit and active params only for the decode bound; reports the measured others and GPU-held memory; verdict names the overflowing term.

evals.prompt: serve Qwen3-Next 80B with 256k context for 4 parallel sessions on this M5 Max
evals.expected_output: Counts only attention layers in --layers, puts Gated DeltaNet recurrent + conv state in --state-gib (charged x4 sequences), checks the engine supports the architecture, and notes mlx_lm.server has no KV quantization flag.

evals.prompt: fit.py says FIT but the model hangs loading and swap grows — another model is already running
evals.expected_output: Reads gpu_alloc/gpu_procs from envelope.sh, compares GPU-held memory + need against iogpu.wired_limit_mb, and names the wired cap (not RAM) as the overflowing term before changing the model.

evals.prompt: write a fused int4 dequant + GEMV Metal kernel using M5 TensorOps and prove the speedup
evals.expected_output: Does not own it: custom Metal/TensorOps kernels and speedup proofs route to the kernel/A-B skill.

evals.prompt: tune decode speed of the GLM model my DS4 server is running
evals.expected_output: Does not own it: a runtime-specific skill for the DS4 server takes over.
